question: Show me all customers in New York
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name, region FROM customers WHERE region = 'New York' ORDER BY customer_id

question: List all customers
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name, region FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id

question: What is total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: Show all orders
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, order_date, total_amount, status FROM orders ORDER BY id

question: List line items
gold_sql: SELECT id, product_name, qty, unit_price FROM line_items ORDER BY id

question: Show customer names and orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.id, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.cust_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.id

question: List customers with null regions
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE region IS NULL ORDER BY customer_id

question: Show completed orders
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' ORDER BY id

question: Show cancelled orders
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY id

question: Count customers by region
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: Count all orders
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

question: Average order value
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS average_order_value FROM orders

question: Largest order
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show New York customer orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.id, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.cust_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'New York' ORDER BY o.id

question: List products
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT product_name FROM line_items ORDER BY product_name

question: Total quantities by product
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM line_items GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY product_name

question: Revenue by customer
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.cust_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_id

question: Top 5 spenders
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.cust_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Orders in January
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2024-02-01' ORDER BY id

question: Count orders by status
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

question: Show order line items
gold_sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, li.product_name, li.qty FROM orders o JOIN line_items li ON li.order_id = o.id ORDER BY li.id

question: Average line item price
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS average_unit_price FROM line_items

question: Customers created in 2023
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE created_at >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND created_at < DATE '2024-01-01' ORDER BY customer_id

question: Order count per customer
gold_sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY cust_id

question: Show customers with more than 5 orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.cust_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 5 ORDER BY c.customer_id

question: What is the highest unit price?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) AS highest_unit_price FROM line_items

question: Show orders after June
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-06-01' ORDER BY id

question: List West customers
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE region = 'West' ORDER BY customer_id

question: Count line items per order
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM line_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id

question: Show customer order totals
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.cust_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.customer_id
